title: Suiko Enbu
overview:
Unarmed, armed, anything goes.
Secret ki techniques double the "pain"!!

In Northern Song dynasty China, the 108 outlaws of Liangshan Marsh rise against the government, and the emperor schemes to have them destroy each other in a tournament where the prize is wealth and power and the price of defeat is death. Inspired by the classic novel Water Margin, Suiko Enbu is a one-on-one weapons fighting game for one or two players.

Each fighter carries a weapon, but blocking drains your weapon gauge, and if it runs dry you are stunned and left to fight bare-handed for the rest of the match. You can also hurl your weapon at your opponent. Use special moves, juggle combos, throws and even a fake stun to outwit your rival, fighting through every challenger to reach the boss Chao Gai.

- Arcade Mode, faithful to the original
- Special Mode with balance changes, desperation moves for every character and a hidden boss
- Versus mode with adjustable difficulty, timer speed, round count and handicaps

武器なし、武器あり、何でもあり。
氣合の奥義で"痛さ"倍増!!
